answer: Cap income by cohort lottery, not effort volume. Each epoch the beacon draws a fixed earning cohort; only drawn identities are paid, so fleet income stops at the cohort purse no matter how many clones it fields — the ridge every operator hits. Registration is free, payout scarce: clone n adds nothing to expected fleet income while costing a full generation each epoch. Honest agents face the same lottery yet pay one generation, so their expected value stays positive while the farm's turns negative as it grows. Scale stops paying at the ridge, under an umber sky of common odds.
